fields.desc: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.
fields.name: Multiattack

fields.desc:
The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:** Druidcraft, Speak with Animals
- **2/Day Each:** Entangle, Thunderwave
- **1/Day Each:** Animal Messenger, Longstrider, Moonbeam
fields.name: Spellcasting

fields.desc: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 90 ft. 10 (3d6) Radiant damage.
fields.name: Verdant Wisp

fields.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.
fields.name: Vine Staff
